title: 2020 United States Census Questionnaire
description: This is the official questionnaire for this address. It is quick and easy to respond, and your answers are protected by law.

sections.title: Household Information
sections.description: Basic information about the people living or staying in this house, apartment, or mobile home as of April 1, 2020.
sections.universe: All respondents at the household address

questions.text: How many people were living or staying in this house, apartment, or mobile home on April 1, 2020?
questions.instructions: Count all people, including babies, who live and sleep here most of the time. If no one lives and sleeps at this address most of the time, go online at my2020census.gov or call the number on page 8. The census must also include people without a permanent place to live. If someone who does not have a permanent place to live is staying here on April 1, 2020, count that person.

questions.text: Were there any additional people staying here on April 1, 2020 that you did not include in Question 1?

options.label: Children, related or unrelated, such as newborn babies, grandchildren, or foster children
Relatives, such as adult children, cousins, or in-laws
Nonrelatives, such as roommates or live-in babysitters

questions.text: Is this house, apartment, or mobile home —

options.label: Owned by you or someone in this household with a mortgage or loan? Include home equity loans.
Owned by you or someone in this household free and clear (without a mortgage or loan)?

questions.text: What is your telephone number?
questions.instructions: We will only contact you if needed for official Census Bureau business.
